Based on my analysis of the codebase and documentation, when a new member is added to the shared ErrorCode union in Server Actions, the following files must be updated:

**Source files** — where the union is defined and used:
- `src/types/api.ts` (the ErrorCode type union definition)
- `src/lib/errors.ts` (HTTP_STATUS_BY_CODE mapping record)

**Documentation files** — that document the error codes:
- `docs/adr/ADR-014-domain-errors-to-error-codes.md` (primary ADR explaining the union and listing all codes)
- `docs/api/actions-overview.md` (lists error codes and their meanings in tables)
- `docs/api/route-handlers.md` (documents HTTP_STATUS_BY_CODE usage in route handlers)
- `docs/design/action-wrapper-and-errors.md` (documents action layer error handling with error code mappings)
- `docs/design/data-flow.md` (references error code mapping)
- `docs/design/service-issue.md` (failure modes table showing error code mappings)
- `docs/design/service-project.md` (failure modes table showing error code mappings)
- `docs/design/service-activity-and-attachment.md` (failure modes table showing error code mappings)
- `docs/design/service-billing-and-usage.md` (references error code mapping)
- `docs/requirements/billing-and-plan-limits.md` (references HTTP_STATUS_BY_CODE)
- `docs/glossary.md` (defines ErrorCode term)

**Test files**:
- `tests/lib/errors.test.ts` (verifies error code mapping for all error classes)

ANSWER: src/types/api.ts, src/lib/errors.ts, docs/adr/ADR-014-domain-errors-to-error-codes.md, docs/api/actions-overview.md, docs/api/route-handlers.md, docs/design/action-wrapper-and-errors.md, docs/design/data-flow.md, docs/design/service-issue.md, docs/design/service-project.md, docs/design/service-activity-and-attachment.md, docs/design/service-billing-and-usage.md, docs/requirements/billing-and-plan-limits.md, docs/glossary.md, tests/lib/errors.test.ts
